The featherdrop wordmark now wears its own typeface.

## Changed

- **Brand wordmark in Bitter.** The "featherdrop" wordmark — in the header and on
  the download page — is now set in Bitter (a humanist slab serif), Medium 500
  Italic, self-hosted via `next/font/google` (subset, preloaded, no external
  request, no font file shipped in the repo). The rest of the interface keeps its
  clean sans-serif.
